The proposal operations, proof packages, scopes, read set, write set, and review evidence are mathematically identical to the independently reconstructed predecessor; the new package correctly supersedes it only to obtain receiver-compatible review records. Conditional C/E routes are excluded.

ordered_step_reconstruction: Put N=n-1. Direct inversion of each positive odd-edge two-by-two block gives P_j^(-1)=[[ell_j,s_j],[s_j,r_j]] with ell_j>s_j>0 and r_j>s_j>0. The negative-edge incidence rows give H_ii=r_i+ell_(i+1)-W_i and H_i,i+1=-s_(i+1).
Set tau_i=s_(i+1)>0 and define z_i by subtracting incident path conductances from H_ii. Entrywise H=L_tau+diag(z), including N=1 with no path edge.

Adjoin one root with formal signed edge z_i at each path vertex. The reduced Laplacian is H. Grouping spanning trees by the retained path forest gives one interval component factor Z_I=sum_(j in I)z_j. The matrix-tree equality is polynomial, so signed z and det(H)=0 are included.

For V=diag(v), q_i=v_i(Hv)_i and e_i=tau_i v_i v_(i+1), direct comparison gives VHV=L_e+diag(q) and det(VHV)=(product_i v_i^2)det(H). The same forest identity therefore has interval charges Q_I=sum_(i in I)q_i.
No premise signs every interval charge, so the proof stops before determinant orientation or reflection.

ordered_step_reconstruction: On a strict internal material-one positive cell, solve U and V between opposite relay rays with U_left=A and U_right=zA. At either event the potential terms cancel, giving C0=A^2 E_mu(theta,z).
Factor E_mu as (sin(mu theta)^2-sin(theta)^2)(1/k_mu-z)(z-k_mu)/(sin(theta)^2 sin(mu theta)^2). The strict phase range makes the prefactor positive, so k_mu<z<1/k_mu.

Low-mode energy U_t^2+rho U^2 is constant on cells and jumps by Delta rho_j U(t_j)^2. Summing Delta rho_j=(R-1)(-1)^j from slopes 1 to p and pairing the n material-one cells yields D=(R-1)C0 sum_a Phi_mu(theta_a,z_a).

The identity z^2E_mu(theta,1/z)=E_mu(theta,z) gives reciprocal oddness of Phi. The exact mu=2, theta=pi/6 cells z=1/2 and 2 are strict local first crossings with opposite Phi, refuting only a cellwise sign mechanism.
For a small common interface translation, M_h=T_R(-h)MT_R(h). At a Dirichlet eigenvalue M=[[1/p,0],[m,p]], so partial_h(M_h)_12=1/p-p while partial_lambda M_12=I/p. Thus lambda'(0)=(p^2-1)/I.
For V/q the speed is (r^2-q^2)/I_V. Equal norm and r^2-q^2=p^2-1 make it D/I, equal to the low-mode speed. The gap derivative cancels and no sign or symmetry follows.
